summary: Regression retest after backend race-condition fix (cliente_partilhar retry) and client-side gating (partilharQuando/sessaoPronta). All fast-click scenarios PASS. Executed 3 back-to-back cycles where COMEÇAR is clicked ~45-91ms after the client page finishes rendering (i.e., well under the previous 3-4s safe window). In every cycle the technician panel showed the client Online with 'A partilhar' badge AND the miniatura (thumb-video-<id>) received a live stream (videoWidth=320). Cycle 0 also validated the full modal flow: click thumb -> modal-ver open (oculto=false) with video-ecra vw=320 and srcObject present; click on video-ecra generates a .circulo-toque on the client (count went 0->1); close modal keeps the miniature live (vw=320 preserved); btn-ver reopens the modal with the same stream. Partilhar/parar/partilhar cycles also worked with videoWidth going back to >0 after each restart.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified. Client-side gate (partilharQuando waiting for sessaoPronta) + backend retry loop (up to 2s) reliably eliminate the sid_sessao race. Recommend keeping BOTH layers so a slow network doesn't break either side.
Consider adding an ack to cliente:partilhar so future regressions surface immediately in the client console.
Minor: btn-comecar text after stop still shows 'COMEÇAR' but the button re-enters sharing on second click within the same session — verified working across 3 iterations.
seed_data_creation: One new session in Histórico from cycle 0 (18:25:08). Others reused existing session id 43a325c6.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Race fix confirmed with elapsed 0.41s-0.70s from fast click to badge+video. Stub getDisplayMedia via context.add_init_script BEFORE opening /cliente.html; canvas.captureStream(10) yields videoWidth=320 headless. Note: #grelha-online has display:none when empty — do NOT wait_for_selector state=visible on it; instead poll for cards inside it. modal-ver hidden via .oculto class (poll classList).
rca_of_the_issue: Previously python-socketio async handlers processed cliente:partilhar before cliente:hello wrote sid_sessao[sid]; handler dropped the event, aPartilhar stayed false. Fix: (a) backend cliente_partilhar retries up to 2s polling sid_sessao, (b) client partilharQuando waits for sessaoPronta before emitting. Both layers now confirmed effective under fast-click load.
